# Facecam regression frames

Small 640px-wide frames from 120–140 second sections, used to verify Haar detection
of real corner webcams. These are regression fixtures, not model training data.

- `facecam_jacksepticeye.jpg`: jacksepticeye, **Five Nights at Freddy's #1 | THE NIGHT SHIFT**,
  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tSqo38kJKmA (approximately 131 seconds).
  Histogram equalization suppresses the real face under the cap; raw grayscale
  retains detections across the sampled interval.
- `facecam_markiplier.jpg`: Markiplier, **WARNING: SCARIEST GAME IN YEARS | Five Nights at Freddy's - Part 1**,
  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iOztnsBPrAA (approximately 131 seconds).
